meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Python 应用部署到 Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把 Flask/Django/FastAPI 应用部署到 Azure
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Flask/Django/FastAPI apps to Azure

howto.what: 安装后，当你说出特定关键词，Claude会把你的Python代码（Flask、Django或FastAPI）部署到Azure App Service上，自动创建所需资源，部署后输出一条消息并停止。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”、“FastAPI App Service”或“deploy Python to App Service”时触发。

say.note: 技能会自动创建资源并上传代码。
技能会检测框架并启动Web应用。
技能会设置正确的启动命令。

howto.what_en: When installed, upon hearing specific keywords, Claude will deploy your Python code (Flask, Django, or FastAPI) to Azure App Service, automatically creating required resources, output a post-deploy message, and stop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", or "deploy Python to App Service".

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to App Service
say_en.note: Skill auto-creates resources and uploads code.

say_en.text: Deploy my Django project to Azure
say_en.note: Skill detects framework and starts web app.
